policy: The canonical Sandbox Tool Policy. It is the only source of what a sandbox may do: which tools a named policy allows, which image a session runs, which resources it gets, which network it sees, whether its workspace is writable and which environment variables a command may set. A tool request names a policy by the name its agent's profile froze into the run; it can never supply a limit, a mount, an image or a network, and the sandbox reads everything else from here. Every value is validated against hard bounds in iacode_sandbox.policy, so zero, negative and absurd values are refused rather than applied.

imageProfiles.name: iacode-dev
imageProfiles.description: Git and Python 3.13 on Debian bookworm slim, enough to run the synthetic repository's tests and the ledger tests of IACode itself. Node is deliberately absent until a Gate needs it.

imageProfiles.name: quality-python
imageProfiles.description: Pinned Python quality toolchain with build, test, lint, coverage, migration, dependency, secret and diff checks.

imageProfiles.name: quality-node
imageProfiles.description: Pinned Node, TypeScript and Angular quality toolchain with an offline dependency cache.

imageProfiles.name: quality-java
imageProfiles.description: Pinned JDK, Maven and Gradle quality toolchain with offline build support.

networkProfiles.name: none
networkProfiles.description: No network interface but loopback. The default of every policy.

networkProfiles.name: local-services
networkProfiles.description: A network of the session's own, created internal, so nothing on it reaches the internet or another session. Reserved for a controlled integration a later Gate attaches to it; no policy of this Gate uses it.

sandboxPolicies.name: developer
sandboxPolicies.description: Reads, searches, writes and patches the workspace, runs commands such as a build or a test suite, and commits locally. No remote Git operation exists.

sandboxPolicies.name: reviewer
sandboxPolicies.description: Reads, searches and inspects history and diffs. It cannot write, patch, run a command or commit.

sandboxPolicies.name: quality-python
sandboxPolicies.description: Runs the frozen Python quality plan against an immutable workspace snapshot without network access.

sandboxPolicies.name: quality-node
sandboxPolicies.description: Runs the frozen Node, TypeScript or Angular quality plan against an immutable workspace snapshot without network access.

sandboxPolicies.name: quality-java
sandboxPolicies.description: Runs the frozen Maven or Gradle quality plan against an immutable workspace snapshot without network access.
